items.html: *And after we explained how, through the raising of the MAN of the souls into Malchut, they give power to ZON to also ascend in the secret of MAN up to AVI, we shall now explain what is the purpose of this ascent. Know, that in the way we explained that ZA cannot give a spirit within his Nukva except according to his power, which is VAK — so too Aba cannot give except according to what is in his power; and behold, he too is not complete, for he has in him only the aspect of the power of Hesed and Gevura and the upper half of the Tifferet of AA, and they still have no grasp and hold in the Mochin of AA at all.
